title: Log your meals by talking and get a daily weight check-in
summary: Tell your bot what you ate, out loud, and it keeps the food log for you. It can also check in on your weight each morning.
what_the_bot_does: Listens when you say what you ate and writes it into a simple food log.
Estimates the basics you care about, like calories or protein, and labels them as estimates.
Checks in each morning about your weight (or reads it from your scale's app if you connect it).
Sends a short weekly summary of trends.
what_you_end_up_with: A food and weight log that fills itself in, without typing into a tracking app.
prompt: Be my food and weight log. When I tell you what I ate, add it to a log with the date, time and a rough estimate of [calories / protein]; label estimates as estimates. Every morning at [time], ask me for my weight and add it. Every [Sunday], send me a short summary of the week's trends. Don't give medical advice; tell me to ask my doctor if something looks off.
watch_out: Calorie and nutrition numbers from a description are rough estimates.
This is health data. Check what your bot's app stores and who can see it.
It's not a doctor. Talk to one before big diet changes, especially with a health condition.

sources.label: X post by @RayFernando1337 (2026-10-20): his Grok Bot logs his food when he talks, gets a morning check-in from his Withings scale and does his receipts (video)
